notes.title: Important news regarding GAME.exe
notes.content:
[b]Hi there people!
I took the time to write this and clarify some things for you guys.[/b]

1- First, let’s talk about the price reduction I announced earlier this month. Sadly the reduction needs to be delayed, I contacted the Steam support and they responded:

[i]“We wouldn't want to change the price of your product right after release. It's pretty important to us that customers have a reasonable expectation when they buy a new game, that the price won't fluctuate right at release.
If you still need to adjust the base price of the game, we'd recommend doing so after a month or more has passed since release. Check out our Pricing documentation for pricing best practices. Thanks!”
- Steam Support[/i]

So, if you want to play GAME.exe for a more reasonable price, i would recommend waiting one more month for the prices to be approved.

2 - Second, localization is extremely hard and expensive to be done properly, and I don’t want to deliver something poorly translated.
The localization update will be delayed, I don’t have a date yet, but the game will be translated at some point, just not in the time I expected.
Another minor update will take place on the 16th of July instead of the localization update.

And that wraps up what I had in mind for GAME.exe, I truly hope you guys understand and have a great experience with my projects, if you have any questions regarding the future of this game, feel free to leave a comment or contact me anywhere!
Thanks for the amazing feedback, even the negative ones, it helps me improve more my final products!

[b]Soon I’ll be announcing a new game, stay tuned on my twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/amarogamedev]@amarogamedev[/url][/b]

notes.title: Small update v1.1
notes.content:
Regarding recent feedback, I decided to change and fix some things!
- When the timer runs out the game no longer closes, it only restarts.
- When you die, you're not locked out of the game, it only restarts.
- You now have 60 seconds of time instead of 45.
